lines: I've got no identity
It won't be born, la la la la
I've got no identity
It won't be born, la la la la
What clothes do you like?
What books? What foods do you like?
Yes, I carry that kind of measuring stick
I'm an ordinary man
A mirror, a shop window
Comparing myself with the person beside me
Yes, I lived believing that was the right way
Why, only now, only now
Is it that I've come to think this way?
Why can I still not see it
Will morning ever come for that thing called being myself?
I've got no identity
It won't be born, la la la la
I've got no identity
It won't be born, la la la la
A girl who waited for the wind
My wet shirt is from this morning's rain
Yes, a thing of the past
Memories of me, still unrefined
The teenage memories I let slip away
Digging them up, I realized
I realized this is my pure, true self
Why, after time has passed, after time has passed
Is it that I've finally come to notice?
Why that thing called being myself, which I couldn't see
Is beginning to make sense
I can't help wanting to shout, wanting to shout
That's why I'm crying
I can't help wanting to realize it
That's why I'm crying
